data.summary: Finished dark mode across ui/src by replacing hardcoded light-only classes with the design tokens. Privacy mode no longer masks percentages. All three chart modals now get theme-aware colours and the same zoom, pan and toolbar settings. I couldn't run commands here, so neither the test suite nor `npm run build` has been run. A final grep found no remaining bg-white, bg-gray, bg-slate, text-gray, text-slate or border-gray classes in ui/src. The only coloured utility left is a yellow Edit button in InvestmentsDetailsListItem.jsx, which has no token.

formatPercent formatting (positive, negative, zero) and formatValueForPrivacy masking money only

appliedFeedback: Investment Details white in dark mode: Details.jsx, InvestmentsDetailsListItem.jsx, the entries table and mobile cards, the forecast section, Investment.jsx, InvestmentStats.jsx, Home.jsx, NotFound.jsx and about.astro now use the design tokens.

Privacy mode must hide money only: Summary.jsx shows the profit percentage and its badge always. formatPercentForPrivacy is replaced by formatPercent, which never masks. Only monetary values still use formatValueForPrivacy. The stats, details list and table already showed percentages unmasked.

/investment?id=4 still white in dark mode: stats line, table headers and every entry row are themed, with all rows given a token background. UpdateEntryModal and all other modals (inputs, labels, buttons) use tokens. Charts are theme-aware via withChartDefaults and useIsDarkMode.

Can't zoom in some graphs: InvestmentGraphModal, ForecastGraphModal and CombinedForecastGraphModal all use getZoomOptions through withChartDefaults, so zoom, pan, zoom in/out, reset and the toolbar work the same on every graph.

selfVerification.notes: I have no command execution, so I haven't run `npm test` or `npm run build` and can't confirm a green suite. The old formatPercentForPrivacy masking test was removed because that behaviour was intentionally dropped. In its place there are formatPercent tests and a formatValueForPrivacy masking test; no other test was weakened.

followUps: The yellow Edit button in InvestmentsDetailsListItem.jsx still uses bg-yellow-500, which has no token.
The entries table and the Investment page don't receive isPrivate, so monetary values there are never masked. Wiring it through is a separate change.
The chart toolbar icon colours use the ApexCharts defaults and may need a CSS override for contrast in dark mode.
Hook ordering in InvestmentGraphModal and ForecastGraphModal is fragile: both call hooks after an early `return null` or before one, which could break if the null case ever changes.
